name: codeql
why: Query engine behind the SoK's static evaluation; CodeQL databases over bootloader source.
description: CodeQL: the libraries and queries that power security researchers around the world, as well as code scanning in GitHub Advanced Security

name: angr
why: Binary analysis platform: symbolic execution and static analysis over stripped firmware.
description: A powerful and user-friendly binary analysis platform!

name: arbiter
why: Static and symbolic detection of the bug classes the SoK evaluates.

name: BootStomp
why: Taint analysis for Android bootloaders; the first bootloader-specific detector.
description: BootStomp: a bootloader vulnerability finder

name: karonte
why: Static taint tracking across firmware binaries and their IPC boundaries.
description: Karonte is a static analysis tool to detect multi-binary vulnerabilities in embedded firmware

name: fwhunt-scan
why: Rule-based scanner for known UEFI threats and vulnerable modules.
description: Tools for analyzing UEFI firmware and checking UEFI modules with FwHunt rules

name: tsffs
why: Simics-based fuzzer targeting firmware and UEFI boot paths.
description: A snapshotting, coverage-guided fuzzer for software (UEFI, Kernel, firmware, BIOS) built on SIMICS

name: efi_fuzz
why: Fuzzer for UEFI DXE drivers, built on a DXE emulator.

name: ASPFuzz
why: Fuzzer for the AMD Secure Processor on-chip bootloader.

name: emmutaler
why: Fuzzer for Apple's iBoot second-stage bootloader.

name: firmadyne
why: Emulation-based dynamic analysis of Linux firmware images.
description: Platform for emulation and dynamic analysis of Linux-based firmware

name: FirmAE
why: Arbitrated emulation; raises firmware rehosting success rates over firmadyne.
description: Towards Large-Scale Emulation of IoT Firmware for Dynamic Analysis

name: emba
why: Firmware analysis orchestrator; runs extraction and many checks in one pass.

name: UEFITool
why: Parse, browse and modify UEFI firmware images.
description: UEFI firmware image viewer and editor

name: uefi_retool
why: IDA tooling for reverse engineering UEFI modules and protocols.
description: A tool for UEFI firmware reverse engineering

name: uefi-firmware-parser
why: Parse UEFI volumes and Intel flash descriptors from Python.
description: Parse BIOS/Intel ME/UEFI firmware related structures: Volumes, FileSystems, Files, etc

name: MEAnalyzer
why: Analyse Intel ME/CSME/TXE firmware regions.
description: Intel Engine & Graphics Firmware Analysis Tool

name: fiano
why: Go tooling to read, modify and rebuild UEFI images.
description: Go-based tools for modifying UEFI firmware

name: binwalk
why: Firmware extraction and filesystem carving.
description: Firmware Analysis Tool

name: FACT_core
why: Firmware analysis and comparison framework.
description: Firmware Analysis and Comparison Tool

name: chipsec
why: Platform security assessment: SMM, SPI, Secure Boot and chipset configuration.
description: Platform Security Assessment Framework

name: fwupd
why: Firmware update service; the delivery side of the boot chain.
description: A system daemon to allow session software to update firmware

name: pesign
why: Sign and inspect PE binaries for Secure Boot.
description: Linux tools for signed PE-COFF binaries

name: top4grep
why: Grep the top four security conferences; the SoK's literature search tool.
description: find relevant security papers published in the top-4 conferences (S&P, USENIX, CCS, NDSS)
